merged_situations.situation: A customer who is not logged in opens any protected screen (home, booking, reservations, profile, deep link, notification tap); the router sends them to the login screen first.
A customer who is not logged in tries to open Domů and is sent to the login screen instead.
A customer who is not logged in tries to open /reservations/:id/edit and is sent to the login screen.
A customer who is not logged in tries to open the checkout; the router sends them to the login screen.
A customer who is not logged in (or whose session ended) opens /payment or /sos/payment, for example from a deep link, and is sent to the login screen instead.
A customer who is not logged in (session expired, deep link) tries to open /success; the router sends them to the login screen.
A customer who is not logged in opens /profile (deep link, header avatar, Motorky menu) and is sent to the login screen instead.
A customer who is not logged in opens the Reservations tab (bottom nav, deep link /reservations or /app/reservations) and is sent to the login screen instead.
A not-logged-in customer opens a reservation detail (deep link, push notification, /app link): redirected to login.
A logged-out customer who opens /messages or /messages/<id> (menu, push, deep link) is redirected to login.
A logged-out customer taps "Domů" or "Rezervace" (and in v2 also "Profil"); the router sends them to the login screen instead of the protected screen.
Pressing REZERVOVAT opens the booking form, which requires a logged-in account; a logged-out customer is redirected to login.
A logged-out customer opening a protected screen (Home, reservations, booking, payment, success, profile, messages, invoices, contracts, all SOS screens, checkout) is sent to /login.
/booking and /payment require a logged-in session.
Contracts require a signed-in customer; without a session the router redirects to login.
Invoices require a signed-in customer; without a session the router redirects to login.
A logged-out user (or expired session) opens any /sos route; the router sends them to login, and creating an incident without a user throws an auth error.
App Link https://motogo24.cz/app/... opens the same screen without the prefix and then passes the same login check.

A customer who is not logged in tries to open Home, Reservations, the booking form, payment, profile, messages, SOS, invoices, contracts or shop checkout, and the app sends them to the login screen instead.
Browsing the shop and the cart is open, but checkout needs login (router).
Messages and threads need login (prefix /messages).
In-app SOS needs login; it does NOT require an active rental in either look (phone numbers are always shown).
A customer who is not signed in tries to open the booking form or the payment screen (also via deep link /app/booking or /app/payment) and is sent to the login screen.
